subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should maintainers keep this as the broad Telegram/reset/session-delivery tracker and sponsor separate scoped fixes, or close/split it in favor of narrower related issues?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans concrete source-backed bugs and product-sensitive UX/telemetry asks; automation should not choose the durable tracker shape or heartbeat/diagnostic policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep And Split
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker, then sponsor separate narrow fixes for reset ordering, self-heal, delivery fallback, and diagnostics.

options.title: Supersede By Narrow Issues
options.body: Close this only if maintainers first designate one or more existing full GitHub issue URLs as canonical owners for every remaining ask.

options.title: Limit To Core Bug
options.body: Narrow this issue to the reset/session-file invariant and ask reporters to open separate feature requests for heartbeat, usage diagnostics, and `/reset --warm` UX.

recommendation.title: Keep And Split
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker, then sponsor separate narrow fixes for reset ordering, self-heal, delivery fallback, and diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The current central file history and prior area ownership signal point to this person as the best available routing owner for the session/runtime boundary choice.
